mapper.select: select f.id as fangjianId, f.loudong, f.louceng, f.fangjianhao, f.fangjian_leixing as fangjianLeixing, c.id as chuangweiId, c.chuangweihao, c.zhuangtai as chuangweiZhuangtai, l.id as laorenId, l.xingming as laorenXingming from fangjian_xinxi f join chuangwei_xinxi c on f.id = c.fangjian_id and coalesce(c.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常' left join chuangwei_shiyong cs on c.id = cs.chuangwei_id and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' left join laoren_xinxi l on cs.laoren_id = l.id where f.zhuangtai != '已删除' order by f.louceng, f.fangjianhao, c.chuangweihao

select id, loudong, louceng, fangjianhao, fangjian_leixing as fangjianLeixing, chuangwei_shu as chuangweiShu, chaoxiang, tupian, zhuangtai, beizhu from fangjian_xinxi where zhuangtai != '已删除' order by louceng, fangjianhao
select id, loudong, louceng, fangjianhao, fangjian_leixing as fangjianLeixing from fangjian_xinxi where zhuangtai != '已删除' order by louceng, fangjianhao
mapper.update: update fangjian_xinxi set loudong = #{loudong}, louceng = #{louceng}, fangjianhao = #{fangjianhao}, fangjian_leixing = #{fangjianLeixing}, chaoxiang = #{chaoxiang}, tupian = coalesce(#{tupian}, tupian), zhuangtai = coalesce(#{zhuangtai}, zhuangtai), beizhu = #{beizhu} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from chuangwei_xinxi where fangjian_id = #{fangjianId} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'

select c.id, c.fangjian_id as fangjianId, f.fangjianhao, f.louceng, c.chuangweihao, c.zhuangtai, c.chuangwei_tupian as chuangweiTupian, c.beizhu from chuangwei_xinxi c join fangjian_xinxi f on c.fangjian_id = f.id where coalesce(c.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常' and f.zhuangtai != '已删除' order by f.louceng, f.fangjianhao, c.chuangweihao
select count(1) from chuangwei_xinxi where id = #{id} and zhuangtai = '空闲' and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
select id, fangjian_id as fangjianId, chuangweihao, zhuangtai, chuangwei_tupian as chuangweiTupian, beizhu from chuangwei_xinxi where id = #{id} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
mapper.update: update chuangwei_xinxi set fangjian_id = #{fangjianId}, chuangweihao = #{chuangweihao}, zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}, chuangwei_tupian = coalesce(#{chuangweiTupian}, chuangwei_tupian), beizhu = #{beizhu} where id = #{id} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
update chuangwei_xinxi set zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select cs.chuangwei_id as chuangweiId, cs.fangjian_id as fangjianId from chuangwei_shiyong cs where cs.laoren_id = #{laorenId} and cs.shiyong_zhuangtai = '正在使用' limit 1
